name: University of Manchester
summary: A large research university in Manchester, north-west England; about 300 undergraduate courses for 2027 entry, with IB offers of 30–39 points.

ib.text: Typical offers are 30–39 points with three HL subjects (HL 7 counts as an A-level A*). Some courses, e.g. Maths, Chemical Engineering and Computer Science, accept only HL Maths: Analysis and Approaches.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: A broad, flexible computer science degree: you choose units to follow your interests and specialise in years 2 and 3, with a team project in year 1 and an optional year in industry on a sister course.
programmes.ib: 37 points with 7,6,6 at HL, including 7 in Maths AA HL (AI is not accepted) and one HL science: Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry or Biology.
programmes.selectionNote: Judged on the UCAS form; exam results weigh most. No aptitude test. Hold an offer for one Computer Science course only.

flagshipSource.title: Computer Science: birthplace of the first stored-program computer, and its first graduates (course overview)

programmes.name: Materials Science and Engineering
programmes.about: How the properties of metals, polymers, ceramics and nanomaterials such as graphene come from their structure, and how to engineer them. Taught in the Home of Engineering and Materials building, beside the National Graphene Institute.
programmes.ib: 35 points with 6,6,5 at HL, two from Maths, Physics and Chemistry at HL; any Maths must be AA (AI is not accepted).

needs.note: Two of the three at HL; if Maths, only Analysis and Approaches is accepted

programmes.selectionNote: Judged on the UCAS form; some candidates are interviewed, usually online. Exam results and interview performance weigh most.

flagshipSource.title: Materials Science and Engineering: advanced materials research, including graphene (course overview)

programmes.name: Medicine
programmes.about: A five-year route to becoming a doctor, learned through themed case discussions, anatomy dissection and clinical placements across Greater Manchester from the first years, with a student-chosen Personal Excellence Path.
programmes.ib: 36 points with 6,6,6 at HL: Chemistry or Biology, another science (or Maths or Psychology) and a third HL subject. Maths and English at GCSE or IGCSE B/6 if not in the Diploma.
programmes.selectionNote: UCAT is required; applicants in SJT band 3 or 4 are not considered. No offers are made without an interview.

flagshipSource.title: Medicine MBChB: the medical school with over 2,500 undergraduate medical students (course overview)

notes: EU students pay the international fee: £39,700 a year for Computer Science and £41,900 for Materials Science and Engineering, for 2027 entry.
Manchester can raise the international fee by up to 7% each year after your first year.
Most courses need no admissions test; Medicine and Dentistry require UCAT.
